purpose: Maintain a prebuilt long-form learning reservoir so content analysis does not depend on just-in-time discovery.
priority_order: new exact-ID discovery until buffer target is restored
verification_needed only when retry due or new source signal
coverage_sources: official YouTube channel long-form surfaces when accessible
official Shorts linking full-video exact IDs
public pages embedding or linking exact YouTube watch IDs
public curriculum/index pages such as DoLearn or other channel-linked indexes
public contemporaneous summaries with exact source identity
stop_rule: Inventory bootstrap is complete only when exact-ID unprocessed buffer reaches target or two independent focused discovery passes produce no additional exact IDs.
